in_sanskrit.name: Aravinth
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Peaceful Mountain
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Aravinth एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Aravinth is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Aravindam' meaning 'peaceful mountain'. This name is associated with the god Aravinda, who is believed to bestow peace and prosperity.
